_derivation.note: MINIMAL-CATALOG case: no Supermetrics enrichment exists for GitHub (context module, not a marketing analytics connector). official_fields.json was hand-curated from the GitHub REST API reference (releases: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases; deployments: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/deployments) pinned to api-version 2022-11-28, cross-checked against the connector.py extraction paths (published_at->date for releases, created_at->date for deployments, ref+environment->label). Field count is intentionally small and honest for a context module that writes context_events, not fact_daily_kpi rows.
_derivation.expansion_rule: none — context module; no metric families to expand
_derivation.count_divergence: 25 fields total: 1 currently extracted (date, exposed), 24 planned. repo_owner and repo_name are derived from connection_config, not the API payload — included for catalog completeness as they scope every event row.

probe.structural_note: GitHub REST returns whole release/deployment objects; fields are object properties, not per-request-selectable columns. ratify_connector.py records a structural ratification (catalog==contract by construction) rather than issuing a field-by-field probe.

_exposure_note: Context module: every cataloged field is extracted from the landed event payloads by construction.
